description: React component for rendering a dynamic, interactive table with grouping, column resizing, drag-and-drop, and permission-based editing features in a board application.

methods.name: resizeColumn
methods.description: Handles resizing of table columns, updates view state, and persists changes via mutator.

methods.name: hideGroup
methods.description: Toggles visibility of a group in the table view.

methods.name: onDropToGroupHeader
methods.description: Handles drag-and-drop of property options to reorder groups.

methods.name: onDropToCard
methods.description: Handles dropping a card onto another card, delegating to group handling.

methods.name: onDropToGroup
methods.description: Handles dropping a card into a group, updating property values and card order.

methods.name: propertyNameChanged
methods.description: Updates the name of a property option.
